sourcing_note_en: Modules 9 to 15 are on disk and every question drawing on them is grounded in an item target read from the files. Modules 1 to 8 are not, apart from fragments. Rather than invent an item list for modules I cannot read, the early-phase questions test fundamentals that the later modules demonstrably depend on — gender agreement, the oblique case, postposition selection, tense forms and the ने construction — because a learner who reaches Module 12 must already have them, whatever order they were taught in. Every such question is marked prerequisite_inferred so that it can be re-pointed at a real source item when the earlier files are merged. UPDATE: Modules 1-8 have since been verified on disk (a separate session). Section A has been re-pointed accordingly — 10 of its 12 questions now cite real source items, 1 was replaced (its original word wasn't in Modules 1-7 after all), and 1 remains prerequisite_inferred pending Module 9.

sections.note_en: Ten of twelve questions re-pointed to real Modules 1-7 items now that those files are verified on disk. Question 4 (भरोसा) was replaced outright — that word is Module 13 vocabulary, not available this session. Question 8 (the ने construction) remains prerequisite_inferred — ने is taught in Module 9, which is not on disk this session; re-point once Module 9's files are uploaded.

questions.prompt_en: यह मेरी ___ है — which noun fits?
questions.explanation_en: मेरी is feminine, and किताब is the only feminine noun offered — one of Module 4's gender-flagged exception words, since nothing about its shape predicts its gender.

questions.prompt_en: What happens to कमरा before a postposition?
questions.explanation_en: में is a postposition, so कमरा must take its oblique form कमरे — Module 6 level 2's exact teaching point.

questions.prompt_en: लोग becomes लोगों before which of these?
questions.explanation_en: लोग is already plural in meaning, and any plural noun before any postposition — को, ने, or otherwise — must carry -ों. Module 6 level 6 teaches this with को; ने (taught later, in Module 9) obeys the identical rule.

questions.prompt_en: राम ___ किताब है — which postposition does Hindi use to express 'having' something?
questions.explanation_en: के पास is how Hindi expresses possession — राम के पास किताब है, 'Ram has a book'. (This question originally tested भरोसा + पर, a Module 13 word not available in this session; replaced with an equivalent postposition-selection question fully grounded in Module 5.)
questions.replacement_note_en: Original question tested भरोसा, sourced from Module 13 vocabulary not on disk this session. Replaced rather than left unverified.

questions.prompt_en: मैं रोज़ वहाँ जाता था means what?
options: I used to go there every day
questions.explanation_en: The habitual past — करता था shape. Module 14 level 14's counterfactual depends on the learner already knowing this participle, since it reuses the same form without था.

questions.prompt_en: Which is the आप imperative of करना?
questions.explanation_en: कर is तू, करो is तुम, कीजिए is आप, and करूँ is the first-person subjunctive. कीजिए is one of exactly four verbs where the regular rule (which predicts करिए) doesn't hold — Module 7 level 27 flags it by name.

questions.prompt_en: वह and इस — what is the relationship?
options: इस is the oblique of यह, and उस of वह
questions.explanation_en: Module 6 level 20 teaches the same mechanism with वह: it has no oblique form of its own, so the pronoun is replaced by a different stem (उस) before a postposition fuses on. इस/उस behave identically, and जो/जिस (Module 14) follows the same pattern again.

questions.prompt_en: मैंने रोटी खाई. Why खाई and not खाया?
options: रोटी is feminine and takes no को, so the verb agrees with it
questions.explanation_en: The ने construction, which Module 9 teaches and Modules 12 to 15 use constantly.
questions.still_blocked_reason_en: The ने construction is taught in Module 9, which is not on disk this session (only Modules 1-8 were available for re-pointing). Re-point once Module 9's level files are uploaded.

questions.prompt_en: Which is the correct plural of लड़की?
questions.explanation_en: लड़कियाँ is the direct plural; लड़कियों (Module 6 level 10) is its oblique form, formed by the identical shorten-the-ी-and-bridge-with-य step this question tests. लड़कों is the oblique plural of लड़का, and लड़के its direct plural — a different noun and class entirely.
questions.source: noun plurals (Module 6, लड़कियों — same mechanism as the direct plural लड़कियाँ)

questions.prompt_en: आज मौसम अच्छा है. Which word would change if मौसम were feminine?
questions.explanation_en: Adjectives ending in -आ agree with the noun's gender wherever they sit in the sentence; those ending in a consonant do not change at all. Module 5 level 17 teaches this exact point with घर अच्छा है / घर अच्छी है.

questions.prompt_en: वह कल आएगा. Which tense is this?
questions.explanation_en: Module 14 level 6 turns on this — Hindi allows the future in a जब clause where English does not. वह जाएगा is the exact third-person-singular future form Module 7 level 22 teaches.

questions.prompt_en: Which of these is NOT a postposition?
questions.explanation_en: और is a conjunction (Module 5 level 24) and does not force the oblique. से, में and पर are all postpositions (Module 5 levels 18-19) and do.

sections.note_en: Only three questions, and only on independently attested content. See the flag.

questions.prompt_en: Which verb takes को on the person told?
questions.explanation_en: उसने मुझे बताया, but उसने मुझसे कहा and उसने मुझसे पूछा. Module 13 level 19 returns to it.

questions.prompt_en: मुझे मिल गया means what?
questions.explanation_en: मिलना covers meeting a person and something becoming available to you.

questions.prompt_en: Why is picking the right verb for a noun tested as a skill in its own right?
options: Because knowing a word and choosing the wrong verb with it is what makes a learner sound translated
Because it is easy to test
questions.explanation_en: पासवर्ड डालना, मुद्दा उठाना, निष्कर्ष निकालना — the principle runs through the whole course.

questions.prompt_en: Which verb refuses ने in the perfective?
questions.explanation_en: बोलना, लाना and भूलना are the three exceptions.

questions.prompt_en: मैंने उसको देखा. Why is the verb neutral?
options: को on the object blocks agreement
questions.explanation_en: ने blocks the subject and को blocks the object, leaving nothing to agree with.

questions.prompt_en: उन्होंने किताबें पढ़ी थीं. What controls the verb?
questions.explanation_en: A feminine plural object with no को.

questions.prompt_en: को on a human object is what?
questions.explanation_en: उसने डॉक्टर को बुलाया — and the neutral verb is the proof it is doing grammatical work.

questions.prompt_en: Which verb goes with भूख?
questions.explanation_en: भूख, प्यास and ठंड take लगना; दर्द and बुखार take होना; नींद and ग़ुस्सा take आना.

questions.prompt_en: मुझे किताबें पसंद ___ — which form?
questions.explanation_en: पसंद agrees with the thing liked, never with the person.

questions.prompt_en: मुझे तैरना आता है means what?
questions.explanation_en: आना for skills. जानना is for facts and people.

questions.prompt_en: मुझे पानी चाहिए and मुझे जाना चाहिए differ how?
options: With a noun it is need; with an infinitive it is should
questions.explanation_en: Module 11 then places चाहिए as the weakest rung of the obligation ladder.

questions.prompt_en: When a noun is the experiencer, what marks it?
questions.explanation_en: बच्चे को भूख लगी है. मुझे and उसे are the fused forms of the same को.

questions.prompt_en: In a compound verb, the main verb appears how?
questions.explanation_en: The vector carries the tense, the agreement and the ने behaviour.

questions.prompt_en: Which vector marks a sudden, involuntary action?
questions.explanation_en: रो पड़ना, हँस पड़ना, उठ पड़ना.

questions.prompt_en: Why does उसने खाना खा लिया take ने but वो खाना खा गया not?
options: The जाना vector makes the whole compound intransitive
questions.explanation_en: The vector overrides the transitivity of the main verb.

questions.prompt_en: नहीं कर पाया rather than नहीं कर सका says what?
options: That you did not manage it, rather than that you were unable
questions.explanation_en: सकना is ability; पाना is managing, often against difficulty.

questions.prompt_en: Which is the strongest rung of the obligation ladder?
questions.explanation_en: पड़ा says you had no choice.

questions.prompt_en: खाना becomes खिलाना. What is the pattern?
options: The vowel shortens and a ल appears
questions.explanation_en: पीना, पिलाना, पिलवाना does the same. Level 18 then names the agent with से.

questions.prompt_en: What does the presumptive होगा do?
questions.explanation_en: अगर उन्होंने कहा है तो सही ही होगा — it must be right, rather than it will be.

questions.prompt_en: In a hospitality exchange, a first refusal of food usually means what?
options: Part of the script — the host is expected to offer again
questions.explanation_en: Module 12 built several dialogues on this, and बस is how a real refusal is finally made.

questions.prompt_en: What survives when Hindi speech is compressed at speed?
questions.explanation_en: Subjects and auxiliaries go first. The postpositions are the listening handhold.

questions.prompt_en: Which suffix does NOT build a feminine noun?
questions.explanation_en: -आव builds masculines from verbs: चुनाव, बदलाव, दबाव.

questions.prompt_en: Sanskrit nouns ending in -आ are which gender?
questions.explanation_en: व्यवस्था, समस्या, चर्चा, घोषणा, प्रतीक्षा — the most reliable gender trap in the language.

questions.prompt_en: मंत्री ends in -ी. What gender is it?
questions.explanation_en: The mirror image of the -आ feminines, one level later.

questions.prompt_en: Which is NOT one of the module's ways of negating?
questions.explanation_en: स- means with — सादर, सहर्ष. The seven negators are निः-, ला-, अ-, बिना, ना-, ग़ैर-, बे-.

questions.prompt_en: What is the most reliable difference between the two vocabulary layers?
options: The Sanskrit side takes the institutions and the compounds
questions.explanation_en: देशभक्ति not मुल्कभक्ति, शिक्षा मंत्रालय not तालीम मंत्रालय.

questions.prompt_en: Which pair matches in gender?
questions.explanation_en: Roughly half the module's pairs mismatch, so each has to be known.

questions.prompt_en: How is a loanword's gender decided?
options: There is a masculine default and a learnable set of feminine exceptions
questions.explanation_en: And every -ing word is feminine: मीटिंग, बुकिंग, पार्किंग.

questions.prompt_en: Which verb takes only feelings as its object?
questions.explanation_en: नाराज़गी जताना, संदेह जताना. Facts take बताना, visible things दिखाना.

questions.prompt_en: झिझक, समझ, माँग, दौड़ — how are these formed?
options: from the bare verb stem, with nothing added
questions.explanation_en: The fifth feminine-making pattern, and the only one that adds nothing.

questions.prompt_en: Which verb sustains something that could be dropped, rather than finishing it?
questions.explanation_en: You cannot निभाना a task, because a task ends.

questions.prompt_en: Why does उम्दा not inflect when बड़ा does?
options: It is only used with masculines
It is Perso-Arabic, and borrowed -आ adjectives stay fixed
questions.explanation_en: ताज़ा, ज़िंदा, बढ़िया behave the same way.

questions.prompt_en: जो लड़का कल आया, ___ मेरा भाई है.
questions.explanation_en: The correlative is required. English has none to drop, which is why learners omit it.

questions.prompt_en: जो goes oblique to what before a postposition?
questions.explanation_en: Exactly as यह goes to इस and वह to उस. जिस plus को fuses to जिसे.

questions.prompt_en: जब तक वो नहीं आता means what?
questions.explanation_en: जब तक needs a negative English has no room for.

questions.prompt_en: Which does Hindi allow that English forbids?
options: The future in a जब clause
The past in a जब clause
questions.explanation_en: जब वो आएँगे, तब बात करेंगे. English cannot say "when he will come".

questions.prompt_en: अगर मैं जाता तो मिलता — what does adding था to both halves do?
options: Turns it into a habitual past that really happened
questions.explanation_en: The counterfactual is the bare imperfect with no auxiliary anywhere.

questions.prompt_en: In अगर ... तो, which half is optional?
questions.explanation_en: तबीयत ठीक नहीं है तो आराम करो. The opposite of what English leads you to expect.

questions.prompt_en: उन्होंने कहा कि मैं कल आऊँगा means what?
options: He said that I will come
He asked whether I would come
questions.explanation_en: Hindi quotes and English rebuilds. मैं refers to him.

questions.prompt_en: Hindi cannot say "I want you to come" in one clause. What does it use?
questions.explanation_en: Same subject takes an infinitive; different subjects force a new clause.

questions.prompt_en: बैठ रहा है means what?
options: He is in the act of sitting down
questions.explanation_en: Positions are states in Hindi. बैठा है is seated.

questions.prompt_en: What does -कर require that के बाद does not?
options: The same subject for both actions
questions.explanation_en: उनके जाने के बाद मैं पहुँचा cannot be said with -कर.

questions.prompt_en: मुझसे इतना नहीं खाया जाता means what?
options: I find myself unable to eat this much
questions.explanation_en: The capability passive is about something in you refusing, not about ability.

questions.prompt_en: How many axes does register have in this course?
options: Two, independent — situation and vocabulary layer
questions.explanation_en: A counter in a government office can be institutional and Urdu-side at once.

questions.prompt_en: कीजिएगा differs from कीजिए how?
questions.explanation_en: Displacing the request into the future makes it unhurried rather than stiffer.

questions.prompt_en: What defines institutional language?
options: It removes the people — no writer, no addressee
questions.explanation_en: A letter has a महोदय and a signature. A notice has neither.

questions.prompt_en: देखते हैं and कोशिश करूँगा are frequently what?
questions.explanation_en: A real yes usually brings a follow-up question about a time or a detail.

questions.prompt_en: जहाँ जैसा माहौल हो, वहाँ वैसी ही भाषा चाहिए. Why is this the course's closing sentence?
options: It nests two correlative pairs and two vocabulary layers, and says there is no form that fits everywhere
questions.explanation_en: Module 14's grammar and Module 15's two axes in one clause, demonstrating what it states.

open_flags: One of the original twelve prerequisite_inferred questions (the ने construction) remains unresolved — it depends on Module 9, still not on disk. The other eleven are now either re-pointed to real Modules 1-7 items or replaced with an equivalent question that is.
Module 8 carries three questions rather than the four an even fifteen-module split would give it, for the same reason as in the Phase 4 checkpoint.

Section D carries thirty of sixty questions. That is deliberate — Phase 5 is where the course's own findings live, and it is also the only phase whose content is fully verifiable. If the earlier modules are merged, the weighting should be revisited rather than left as an artefact of what happened to be readable.
